description: Two views of the same small chibi pixel art character, bald, with long pointed ears: on the left seen from the front, on the right seen from behind. Paint only inside the white of the mask: give the bald head two big round space buns high on top of the head, and short side-swept bangs, the same hairstyle in both views, in big bold locks. The hair is one bright grass green, shaded only with darker greens and outlined with the same thick dark outline, with no other colours inside the hair. The long pointed ears still poke out through the hair. Do not change the face, the eyes, the body or the clothes. Keep the same chunky pixel size and the same flat shading, nothing else added, transparent background.
